title: FlashFolio: A GPU-Accelerated Solver for Portfolio Optimization
summary: We present FlashFolio, a GPU-accelerated solver for single-period and multi-period portfolio optimization with factor-based risk modeling, bid-offer spread costs, and nonlinear market impact. These models are widely used in portfolio construction and optimal execution, but become computationally challenging at large scale, especially in the multi-period setting. We benchmark FlashFolio against MOSEK on instances constructed from realistic market inputs.
